# MyDailyDevTools

> Essential developer tools for everyday tasks. Fast, free, and privacy-focused web tools including JSON formatter, URL encoder, Base64 converter, hash generator, password generator, text diff checker, UUID generator, QR code generator, and delimiter converter.

## Overview

MyDailyDevTools provides a comprehensive suite of developer utilities that run entirely in the browser. No data is sent to servers, ensuring complete privacy. All tools are free to use and require no registration.

## Available Tools

### Text & Data Tools
- **JSON Formatter** (/json-formatter): Format, validate, and minify JSON data with syntax highlighting
- **Base64 Encoder/Decoder** (/base64): Encode and decode text or files to/from Base64 format
- **Text Diff Checker** (/text-diff): Compare two texts side-by-side with highlighted differences
- **Delimiter Converter** (/delimiter-converter): Convert between CSV, TSV, pipe-delimited and custom formats with auto-detection for Excel paste

### Security & Hashing
- **Hash Generator** (/hash-generator): Generate MD5, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes for any input
- **Password Generator** (/password-generator): Create secure passwords with customizable length and character types

### Web & URLs
- **URL Encoder/Decoder** (/url-encoder): Safely encode and decode URLs for web use
- **QR Code Generator** (/qr-generator): Generate QR codes for text, URLs, or any data

### Identifiers
- **UUID Generator** (/uuid-generator): Generate version 4 UUIDs with bulk generation support

## Key Features

- **Privacy First**: All processing happens client-side in the browser
- **No Registration**: Use all tools immediately without creating an account
- **Fast Performance**: Optimized for speed with Next.js and React
- **Mobile Friendly**: Responsive design works on all devices
- **Free Forever**: Supported by non-intrusive advertising
- **GDPR Compliant**: Cookie consent with full functionality without tracking

## Technical Details

Built with:
- Next.js 14 (App Router)
- TypeScript for type safety
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- React hooks for state management
- Client-side processing for privacy

## API Usage

All tools are web-based and do not provide programmatic APIs. For automation needs, consider using the browser's developer console to interact with the tools.

## Privacy and Compliance

- GDPR compliant with cookie consent banner
- No personal data collection without consent
- All tool processing happens locally
- Google Analytics only with explicit consent
- No cookie walls - full functionality without cookies
